Session open. Chapter 2. Approval: autopilot. Spoilers: off.

## Changed since last session
Nothing changed since the last session.

## Settings
- as of: Spring, year 300
- genre: low fantasy
- tone: grim
- difficulty: balanced
- length: standard
- pacing: balanced
- dice: GM rolls
- turn_length: standard
- lines: harm to children

## Voice anchor
Interior level: deep
Clipped, close third person, past tense. Plain diction, hard edges, dry humor; violence quick and ugly.

## Load guide: The Free Cities

Generated from the wiki; do not edit. Lists every page in this world and when to load it.

As of: Spring, year 300

### Places
Load when a scene is set there.

- [Dragon's Den](places/dragons-den.md): A district of eastern Volantis.
- [Long Bridge](places/long-bridge.md): The bridge joining the two halves of Volantis. Closed by the Triarch's order: crossing needs a stamped pass.
- [Volantis](places/volantis.md): The oldest of the Free Cities, split by the Black Wall.

### Factions
Load when the faction or its members act.

- [Golden Company](factions/golden-company.md): The largest sellsword company in Essos, camped outside Volantis. It owes Triarch Malaquo two months of grain bought on credit.

### Characters
Load when the character is present or discussed.

- [Brother Olyvar](characters/brother-olyvar.md): The company septon. Died of fever in ch-01; buried outside the Black Wall.
- [Dagna](characters/dagna.md): A river smuggler. Dead (ch-01): killed by Marro in the alleys; her body went into the Rhoyne.
- [Hesse](characters/hesse.md): Company sergeant. Lost her left eye to the Triarch's men and wears a patch. Her horse, Ash, is lame.
- [Lissa](characters/lissa.md): A ferry-girl on the Rhoyne. Her mother lives in the Dragon's Den district.

- [Rickard Snow](characters/rickard-snow.md): Sellsword captain of the Golden Company, camped outside Volantis. A crossbow bolt wound in his left shoulder (ch-01): he can't raise a shield or draw a bow with that arm.
- [Ser Tobbin](characters/ser-tobbin.md): A hedge knight who sells his sword to the company. Dagna's brother.
- [Triarch Malaquo](characters/triarch-malaquo.md): One of the three Triarchs of Volantis.

### Items

- [Lissa's letter](items/lissas-letter.md): A letter Lissa gave Marro to carry to her mother in the Dragon's Den.
- [Old whetstone](items/old-whetstone.md): Rickard's old whetstone, given to Marro. Marro carries it.

input.summary: Captains' council in the big pavilion. Lysono says someone in camp is talking to the Triarch and he will find the leak; a captain asks why the Triarch feeds an army in his ditch. Marro, holding Rickard's helm, sees Rickard touch the strongbox key cord at his collar, and Lysono sees Marro notice. Rickard announces he will draw the next plan alone and hold it, and that he will lead the first assault, but cannot take his shield on his wounded arm in front of the council. Ser Tobbin presses Marro about his missing sister Dagna; Marro stays silent, and Tobbin demands they talk about the river tonight.

updates.body: The Triarch's grain barges, due to the Golden Company on credit, did not arrive at the start of chapter 2.
A fortnight before chapter 2, the Triarch's men waited with pitch at the south-bend ford the captains had chosen in council the same night.

Rickard told the council he will draw the next assault plan alone and keep it, giving orders only the morning they march; Lysono demanded to read it, guessing it will sit in the strongbox. Rickard said he would lead the first assault himself, then could not take his shield on his wounded left arm in front of the captains.
In council Marro saw Rickard's hand go to the strongbox key cord when the captains asked why the Triarch feeds them; Lysono saw Marro notice and wrote something in his ledger.

Ser Tobbin says Dagna failed to meet him with a boat three nights back. He publicly asked Marro, who was in the river alleys that night, whether he saw her; Marro said nothing. Tobbin told Marro they will talk about the river tonight. Tobbin still does not know she is dead.

thread_changes.title: Tobbin's question
thread_changes.body: Ser Tobbin wants to talk to Marro about the river tonight; he suspects Marro saw Dagna. Marro killed her.
Lysono is hunting the leak and wants to read Rickard's next plan; Marro saw Rickard reach for the key cord.
